storage_note: SignalStudio defines the table fields, keys, and case rows for a separate backend AI to implement. #1001 generates asset_id once as UUIDv7; #1002 and other tables reuse that exact ID. PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, or Parquet may be chosen there if the same semantics are preserved; no table write is performed by these case rows.

assets.purpose_zh: 一个 asset_id 对应一个内部资产对象；只有 X 账号时可暂用账号名称，身份仍待确认。

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 系统创建的内部资产 ID（UUIDv7）

columns.name: name
columns.label_zh: 当前展示名称；待确认时可暂用来源名称

columns.name: asset_kind
columns.label_zh: 对象类别，如社交账号、项目、加密资产、股票；尚不确定时可空

assets.create_sql: CREATE TABLE assets (asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, identity_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (identity_status IN ('pending_identity', 'confirmed')), asset_kind TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
assets.purpose_en: Store stable internal asset objects with a current display name that may be provisional while identity is pending.

asset_identifiers.purpose_zh: 用来源范围或别名类别加标识值找到 #1001 的内部资产 ID；一行只保存一条对应关系，多行可以指向同一资产。

columns.name: external_identifier
columns.label_zh: 外部 ID 或别名值

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 引用 #1001 已创建的 asset_id（UUIDv7）；#1002 不另生成

asset_identifiers.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_identifiers (source_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, external_identifier TEXT NOT NULL, asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), PRIMARY KEY (source_namespace, external_identifier))
asset_identifiers.purpose_en: Map each source-scoped identifier or curated alias to an existing internal asset ID; multiple rows may point to one asset.

asset_relationships.purpose_zh: 保存两项已确认资产之间经过审核的关系。
asset_relationships.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_relationships (relationship_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, from_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), to_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), relationship_type TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_ref TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (from_asset_id <> to_asset_id))
asset_relationships.purpose_en: Store reviewed relationships between approved assets.

asset_monitoring_rules.purpose_zh: 按资产保存经审核的规则及其版本。
asset_monitoring_rules.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_monitoring_rules (rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), metric_key TEXT NOT NULL, rule_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, effective_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rule_id, version))
asset_monitoring_rules.purpose_en: Store reviewed, versioned monitoring rules for assets.

asset_score_events.purpose_zh: 汇集各评分程序已经确认的加分事实；每笔分引用详细判定记录，并使用稳定 event_key 防重。规划经待评审的评分事件 Topic 分别投影至 Redis 与 Delta/Parquet 长期流水；Redis 不是唯一账本。

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 引用 #1001 的内部资产 ID

columns.name: event_key
columns.label_zh: 由资产 ID、评分维度和判定记录引用稳定生成的去重键

columns.name: score_key
columns.label_zh: 本次加分所属指标；全量热度 Demo 固定为 total_heat，新指标需另行定义

columns.name: decision_ref
columns.label_zh: 评分程序命名空间和其详细判定记录 ID；据此查询原始输入、命中原因和规则版本

columns.name: score_delta
columns.label_zh: 本次入账的分数变化量；看空证据通常给看空维度加正分，明确扣分或冲销可为负数

columns.name: created_at
columns.label_zh: 评分事件被系统接受时确定的入账时间，UTC；实时窗口和归档沿用同一时间

columns.name: decay_policy_ref
columns.label_zh: 该笔事件首次接受时确定的不可变衰减规则版本；用于校验与追溯

columns.name: half_life_minutes
columns.label_zh: 该笔事件首次接受时确定的正数半衰期分钟数；Demo 为 10080，归档与缓存沿用

asset_score_events.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_score_events (asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), event_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, score_key TEXT NOT NULL, decision_ref TEXT NOT NULL, score_delta REAL NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, decay_policy_ref TEXT NOT NULL, half_life_minutes REAL NOT NULL CHECK (half_life_minutes > 0), UNIQUE (asset_id, score_key, decision_ref))
asset_score_events.purpose_en: Collect deduplicated score contributions from program-owned decision records by asset and score dimension.

asset_scores_current.purpose_zh: 保存各资产评分在 calculated_at 时刻的值；Demo 只使用 total_heat 全量热度。新资产首次建档贡献 +100，按 7 天（10080 分钟）半衰；后续贡献可按各自规则衰减后汇总。#3005 从 Redis 评分事件更新本表，排名在同一查询时刻计算，尚未运行。

columns.name: asset_id
columns.label_zh: 引用 #1001 的内部资产 ID

columns.name: score_key
columns.label_zh: 评分指标唯一键；本次 Demo 固定为 total_heat（全量热度）

columns.name: score_value
columns.label_zh: 该资产在此指标上的当前分数；内部保留计算精度，仅展示保留两位小数

columns.name: calculated_at
columns.label_zh: score_value 对应的 UTC 时刻；连续指数衰减指标读取时折算到实际查询时刻

asset_scores_current.create_sql: CREATE TABLE asset_scores_current (asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(asset_id), score_key TEXT NOT NULL, score_value REAL NOT NULL, calculated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, score_key))
asset_scores_current.purpose_en: Materialize the latest value of each program-owned score metric for each asset; calculate ranks when querying.
